# Zencastr

> > Zencastr is an all-in-one AI-powered platform for recording, editing, and monetizing audio and video content with studio-quality tools designed for creators.

Zencastr provides creators with integrated tools for podcast production, video creation, and content distribution across major platforms like Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and YouTube. The platform combines remote recording capabilities, AI-powered editing, transcription, dynamic ad insertion, and clip generation to streamline the entire content creation workflow.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered editing
- Podcast hosting and distribution
- Remote recording
- Creator monetization
- Video creation and repurposing
- Transcription
- Dynamic ad insertion
- Content distribution
- Collaborative teams
- Analytics and insights
- Mobile recording
- 4K video support
- Creator Network
- Embeddable player
- Social media clips

## Core Platform & Overview

- [Zencastr Homepage](https://zencastr.com): Zencastr homepage showcasing complete audio/video platform with AI editing and monetization
- [Product Tour](https://zencastr.com/product-tour): Interactive tour of Zencastr's recording, editing, and distribution capabilities
- [Pricing](https://zencastr.com/pricing): Zencastr subscription plans and pricing for different creator types

## Recording & Production

- [Studio-Quality Recording](https://zencastr.com/feature/recording): Remote studio-quality audio/video recording from browser or iOS app
- [AI-Powered Editing](https://zencastr.com/feature/editing): AI-powered text-based audio and video editing with professional enhancements
- [Transcription](https://zencastr.com/feature/transcription): AI-powered 99% accurate transcription for audio and video recordings
- [Zencastr Mobile](https://zencastr.com/feature/mobile): Zencastr Mobile iOS app for on-the-go recording, editing, and monetization
- [ZenCloud Storage](https://zencastr.com/feature/zencloud): ZenCloud storage with backup, sync to Dropbox and Google Drive
- [Teams & Collaboration](https://zencastr.com/feature/teams): Zencastr Teams for collaborative content production with role-based access

## Content Distribution & Hosting

- [Podcast Hosting](https://zencastr.com/feature/hosting): Unlimited podcast hosting with distribution to Spotify, Apple, YouTube
- [Video RSS](https://zencastr.com/feature/rss): Video RSS conversion for multimedia podcast distribution and repurposing
- [Embeddable Player](https://zencastr.com/feature/player): Embeddable HD/4K player for content distribution and integration

## Content Repurposing & Growth

- [AI-Generated Clips](https://zencastr.com/feature/clips): AI-generated viral clips for TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Facebook
- [Video Creator Tools](https://zencastr.com/uses/video-creator): ZenAI-powered video creation and repurposing for social media platforms

## Monetization & Analytics

- [Monetization](https://zencastr.com/feature/monetize): Creator Network monetization through ads, sponsorships, and host-read programs
- [Dynamic Ad Insertion](https://zencastr.com/feature/flights): Dynamic ad insertion feature for podcast monetization and revenue optimization
- [Analytics](https://zencastr.com/feature/analytics): Zencastr Advanced Analytics for audience insights and performance metrics

## Use Cases

- [Podcasting](https://zencastr.com/uses/podcasting): Zencastr's AI-powered platform for podcast growth and audience expansion
- [Interviewing](https://zencastr.com/uses/interviewing): Zencastr platform optimized for high-quality interview recording and distribution
